metadata.name: wikidoc
metadata.description: (article) - passthrough for the wiki window's content cel: renders the article vnode wiki.open assembled, or a hint when none is open.

metadata.name: wiki
metadata.description: (name?) - a button that opens the wiki window on `name` (a cel key, function, segment, or win.<id> layer). =wiki("runCycle"). The article shows summary/doc metadata, the formula source, links to the functions it calls and its input cels (from inputMap), backlinks, a force-directed neighborhood graph, and an editable note saved to metadata.note. Navigation: click any link or graph node.

metadata.name: wiki.open
metadata.description: dispatch (state, key) - assemble the wiki article for `key` (a window state ref like win.x.state articles its layer), stash it in wiki.article, lazily create + open + raise the win.wiki window (the frame only when origin's mount resolves), paint. The W titlebar button and every in-article link dispatch this.

metadata.name: wiki.saveNote
metadata.description: dispatch (state) - write the wiki.noteDraft buffer to the current entry's metadata.note (metadata-only setCel: merges, never touches structure). Layer-1 set-policy refusals surface in the draft box instead of throwing.

metadata.name: wiki.current
metadata.description: the key the wiki window is showing (set by wiki.open).

metadata.name: wiki.article
metadata.description: the assembled article vnode for wiki.current (a snapshot built at open time; navigating refreshes).

metadata.name: wiki.noteDraft
metadata.description: the note editor's buffer (set-binding from the textarea; wiki.saveNote commits it).

metadata.name: wiki.saveDesc
metadata.description: dispatch (state) - write the wiki.descDraft buffer to the current entry's metadata.description (metadata-only setCel). The wiki is editable: every render (inspect, vocab, wiki, skill) reads the same field. Runtime-local until the document dehydrates.

metadata.name: wiki.descDraft
metadata.description: the description editor's buffer (set-binding from the textarea; wiki.saveDesc commits it).

metadata.name: wiki.notes
metadata.description: the annotation sidecar: key → note text. Notes point AT their subject (locked natives are annotatable); dehydrates with the document. The annotation plane supersedes this when it ships.

metadata.name: wikisrc
metadata.description: (doc) - the source window's content: a node's LIVE source (formula f, or the bound native's toString - always the running code) + its github link. GitHub cannot be iframed (X-Frame-Options deny); the live source is strictly better anyway.

metadata.name: wiki.openSource
metadata.description: dispatch (state, key) - open the ⧉ source window on a node: live source + github link, in its own draggable window (lazy win.wikisrc, the win.wiki pattern).

metadata.name: wiki.srcDoc
metadata.description: the source window's document ({key, src, gh}; set by wiki.openSource).
